profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer currently working for Salesforce in the Indianapolis hub. My main focus is on full stack web development with a concentration on web based technologies.

If you would like to chat about the constantly changing healthcare industry or know of any good learning opportunities please contact me at "nelson.weston89@gmail.com".

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Maintained the code repository for the application Copia, a Web-based LIS whose purpose is the processing of laboratory data between medical entities and the automation of workflow within a lab to reduce errors in resulting and reporting of medical instruments.
	Developed new features for the Copia application ranging from minor (single line changes) to major (13000 lines plus) changes based on client’s needs and the forecast needs of the company, based on where the application would be transitioning to in the future.
	Fixed an array of issues based on internal review by our testing department and the feedback of our clients. These issues ranged from serious to inconvenient and were addressed in either a hotfix or our next major release. 
	Trained new hires in the workflow of Copia, interactions of server-side Java (servlets) with HTML/JavaScript and Orchard Software documentation, standards and protocols. 
	Assisted in the hiring of new team members including resume review, interviewing and input on the final decision for the best candidate.
	Maintained local Git repository and multiple SQL databases including the creation of routine backups for local databases.
	All Java/JavaScript application development was done in the Eclipse IDE with a Tomcat service and Microsoft SQL management Studios 2012/2016 for the backend data storage.

positions.title: Academic Skills Tutor
positions.description:
- Specialized in time management, note taking, test taking, and study habits
- Ensured the student attendance is accurate during Academic Student Seminars

positions.title: Comptroller Reconciliation Intern
positions.description:
- Reconciling past and present projects to allow the comptroller's office the ability to close projects that had reached the end of their term within Encompass, the State of Indiana's accounting system

- Trained to use Project Costing and General Ledger within the State of Indiana's accounting system Encompass 

- Created Excel VBA based applications to automate and increase task efficiency in the comptroller's office and SQL queries to build reports that allow the comptroller's office to better track funds throughout the year

- Organized and archived fiscal year records to increase record lookup speeds and allow room for the state’s new fiscal year

- Developed workflows in SharePoint 2010 which enabled two different accounting systems (state and federal) to reconcile their service and purchase contracts

company.name: State Office of The Adjutant General

positions.title: Application and Development Intern
positions.description:
- Created a development resource site using Google sites to centralize all documentation of IT projects  
- Developed detailed forms, reports and custom modules in Drupal for OFS Brands "My OFS Brands" site which is their central hub for all of their users and customers
- Moved, managed and created backend MySQL databases for the My OFS Brands site to allow better indexing and customization of the site
